arguments.analyst: Round 3: O10 (E6D:K126R, 3.72) and O6 (I136T:Q184R, 3.70) show mild substitutions near the N-terminus and surface residues preserving brightness; O9 (3.63) supports conservative surface edits. I test whether these conservative-menu analogs retain the 3.4–3.5 band.
arguments.hypothesis: Conservative class-preserving edits at surface/exposed positions (K156R, T230N, V61A, T62A, K3R, H81R) preserve brightness near the 3.4–3.5 log band, while D216E paired with the partially destabilizing L141Q/E132G combo will score lower.
